description: What the suite of the pure part of git_push (lib/git-push.mjs) must notice: which names may be pushed, what is shown of an address and of Git's output, how the log, the diffstat and the porcelain answer are read, what the scan of the commits looks for, and what the approval card is told. One exact replacement per mutation, each pattern occurring once.

mutations.name: limit-commits
mutations.what: the card lists more than fifty commits

patches.old: commits: 50, // commits listed on the approval card
patches.new: commits: 500, // commits listed on the approval card

mutations.name: limit-timeout
mutations.what: a push gets a minute, not ninety seconds

mutations.name: branch-dash
mutations.what: a name that starts with - (an option) is a branch

mutations.name: branch-plus
mutations.what: a name that starts with + (a forced refspec) is a branch

mutations.name: branch-full-ref
mutations.what: refs/heads/x or refs/tags/x is a branch name

mutations.name: branch-forbidden-characters
mutations.what: the characters that Git forbids in a ref are not looked for at all

mutations.name: branch-colon
mutations.what: a colon is allowed in a name (src:dst refspec)

mutations.name: branch-wildcards
mutations.what: ? * and [ are allowed in a name (a pattern)

mutations.name: branch-tilde-caret
mutations.what: ~ and ^ are allowed in a name (a revision)

mutations.name: branch-backslash
mutations.what: a backslash is allowed in a name

mutations.name: branch-control-characters
mutations.what: a C1 control character is allowed in a name

mutations.name: branch-format-characters
mutations.what: a bidi or zero-width character is allowed in a name

mutations.name: branch-separators
mutations.what: a no-break space or another Unicode space is allowed in a name

mutations.name: branch-surrogates
mutations.what: a lone surrogate is allowed in a name

mutations.name: branch-private-use
mutations.what: a private-use character is allowed in a name

mutations.name: branch-unassigned
mutations.what: an unassigned code point is allowed in a name

mutations.name: branch-double-dot
mutations.what: a name with .. (a range) is a branch

mutations.name: branch-at-brace
mutations.what: a name with @{ (a reflog reference) is a branch

mutations.name: branch-lone-at
mutations.what: @ alone (HEAD) is a branch

mutations.name: branch-trailing-dot
mutations.what: a name that ends with a dot is a branch

mutations.name: branch-pseudo-ref
mutations.what: HEAD, FETCH_HEAD and the other pseudo refs are branches

mutations.name: branch-empty-component
mutations.what: a name with an empty component (a//b, /a, a/) is a branch

mutations.name: branch-dot-component
mutations.what: a component that starts with a dot is allowed

mutations.name: branch-lock-component
mutations.what: a component that ends with .lock is allowed

mutations.name: branch-too-long
mutations.what: a name of 201 characters is a branch

mutations.name: branch-not-a-string
mutations.what: a number or an object is looked at as if it were a name

mutations.name: branch-empty
mutations.what: the empty name is not caught by its own test
mutations.equivalent: The empty name still fails the last rule (its only component is empty), so the explicit length test is a redundant first line of defence.

mutations.name: remote-too-long
mutations.what: a remote name of 65 characters is accepted

mutations.name: remote-leading-dash
mutations.what: a remote name may start with - (an option)

mutations.name: remote-slash
mutations.what: a remote name may hold a / (a path)

mutations.name: remote-not-a-string
mutations.what: a number is a remote name

mutations.name: arguments-skip-remote
mutations.what: the remote of a call is not checked

mutations.name: arguments-skip-branch
mutations.what: the branch of a call is not checked

mutations.name: protected-only-main
mutations.what: master may be pushed

mutations.name: protected-only-master
mutations.what: main may be pushed

mutations.name: protected-case
mutations.what: Main and MASTER may be pushed

mutations.name: protected-default-case
mutations.what: the default branch is compared with its case

mutations.name: protected-default-ignored
mutations.what: the default branch of the remote may be pushed

patches.old: const isDefault = typeof defaultBranch === 'string' && defaultBranch !== '' && name === defaultBranch.toLowerCase();

mutations.name: protected-no-way-out
mutations.what: the refusal does not say what to do instead

mutations.name: url-user-kept
mutations.what: the user part of an http(s) address (a token) is shown

mutations.name: url-ssh-user-hidden
mutations.what: the user name of an ssh address is hidden too

mutations.name: url-ssh-password-shown
mutations.what: the password of an ssh address is shown

mutations.name: url-first-at
mutations.what: the user part ends at the first @, so a password with an @ in it leaks its end

mutations.name: url-no-parts
mutations.what: no address is taken apart

mutations.name: url-query-token
mutations.what: a token in the query of an address is shown

mutations.name: url-not-a-string
mutations.what: something that is not an address is shown as text

mutations.name: output-addresses
mutations.what: an address in Git's output keeps its credentials

mutations.name: output-known-secrets
mutations.what: a secret that the Hub knows is not replaced in Git's output

patches.old: for (const secret of secrets) if (typeof secret === 'string' && secret.length >= 4) out = out.split(secret).join(SECRET_MARK);

mutations.name: output-token-shapes
mutations.what: a token that Git's output prints is not replaced

mutations.name: output-unbounded
mutations.what: Git's output is returned whole, however long

mutations.name: log-short-record
mutations.what: a record with a commit hash but no date or subject is a commit

mutations.name: log-any-hash
mutations.what: a record whose first field is not a commit hash is a commit

mutations.name: log-author-uncut
mutations.what: an author name is not cut

mutations.name: log-subject-uncut
mutations.what: a subject is not cut

mutations.name: log-short-hash
mutations.what: the short hash has eight characters

mutations.name: log-subject-first-field
mutations.what: a subject that holds the field separator is cut at it

mutations.name: stat-first-line
mutations.what: the totals are read from the first line of the diffstat

mutations.name: stat-no-deletions
mutations.what: a diffstat with insertions only has NaN deletions

mutations.name: stat-no-insertions
mutations.what: a diffstat with deletions only has NaN insertions

mutations.name: porcelain-rejected
mutations.what: a rejected ref is not counted

mutations.name: porcelain-done
mutations.what: the word Done is not noticed

mutations.name: porcelain-url
mutations.what: the address of the remote is not read

mutations.name: porcelain-reason
mutations.what: the reason of a rejection is lost

mutations.name: scan-limit
mutations.what: a range longer than the limit is read anyway

mutations.name: scan-removed-lines
mutations.what: a removed line is read as if it were added

mutations.name: scan-context-lines
mutations.what: an unchanged line is read as if it were added

mutations.name: scan-plus-plus
mutations.what: an added line that reads +++ is taken for a file header and not read

mutations.name: scan-no-hunk
mutations.what: the first @@ does not start the lines of content, so nothing is read

mutations.name: scan-deleted-file
mutations.what: a deleted file is not told apart from a changed one

patches.old: else if (line.startsWith('deleted file mode')) file.deleted = true;
patches.new: else if (line.startsWith('deleted file mode')) file.deleted = false;

mutations.name: scan-deletion-is-protected
mutations.what: deleting a protected file is refused like adding one

mutations.name: scan-protected-ignored
mutations.what: a protected file is never reported

mutations.name: scan-binary
mutations.what: a binary file is not recognised

mutations.name: scan-binary-count
mutations.what: binary files are not counted

mutations.name: scan-binary-read
mutations.what: a binary file is read as text
mutations.equivalent: A binary file has no hunk, so it has no added line to read: the test on top of the read is a redundant guard.

mutations.name: scan-rename-target
mutations.what: a renamed file is looked at under its old name
mutations.equivalent: The diff --git header of a rename names the new path as well, and git prints both together, so the rename line repeats what the header says.

patches.old: else if (line.startsWith('rename to ')) file.path = unquoteGitPath(line.slice('rename to '.length));

mutations.name: scan-commit
mutations.what: a finding does not say which commit added it

mutations.name: scan-leaks-text
mutations.what: a finding carries the text that was found

patches.new: report.findings.push({ commit, file: file.path, labels, text: added });

mutations.name: scan-single-match
mutations.what: one match is not enough to be a finding

mutations.name: scan-chars
mutations.what: the number of characters read is not counted

mutations.name: scan-files
mutations.what: the files are not counted

mutations.name: scan-commits
mutations.what: the commits are not counted

mutations.name: detail-no-cap
mutations.what: the card is given every commit, however many

mutations.name: detail-omitted
mutations.what: the card does not count the commits that are not listed

mutations.name: detail-kind
mutations.what: the card does not say it is a push

mutations.name: detail-address
mutations.what: an address that arrives with credentials is shown with them

mutations.name: detail-long-hash
mutations.what: a commit is shown by its whole hash

mutations.name: detail-upstream
mutations.what: the card never says that the upstream is set

mutations.name: detail-stat-uncut
mutations.what: a long diffstat is shown whole

mutations.name: detail-stat-room
mutations.what: the cut diffstat keeps two lines too many

mutations.name: detail-stat-count
mutations.what: the cut diffstat counts the lines that were left out wrongly
